description: This file defines the Supervisor Data Transfer Object (DTO) class used within the OrangeHRM project. The class encapsulates supervisor-related data for reports, providing methods for normalization and retrieval of supervisor details such as name, ID, and reporting method. It interacts with Employee and ReportingMethod entities and utilizes traits for ORM and employee services.

classes.name: Supervisor
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object for representing supervisor information within report contexts, capable of normalizing supervisor data and fetching supervisor-related attributes such as name, ID, and reporting method.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Supervisor DTO with the given employee number.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns an array of normalized supervisor data based on specified fields.

methods.name: callGetterOnItem
methods.description: Retrieves specific supervisor attribute values, including special handling for reporting method.

methods.name: getFieldGetterMap
methods.description: Provides a mapping between field names and their getter methods.
